"""Verification tables for the final picks (2025-26):
area_stats  : plain numbers in each area of RR's moments - league, champions (RCB), RR's current players, the new targets
type_phase  : IPL 2025-26 bowling by pace/spin and phase - RR v champions v league
bat_types   : IPL 2025-26 batting by batter hand x bowler type - RR v champions v league
target_spin : middle-overs batting v wrist spin / finger spin / pace for targets and RR's middle order (IPL + top-nine T20Is)"""
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, json, pathlib
W = pathlib.Path("/home/claude/work"); O = pathlib.Path("/home/claude/dash13"); O.mkdir(exist_ok=True); CODE = pathlib.Path(__file__).read_text()
sq = pd.read_csv(W / "squads2027.csv"); rr = set(sq[sq.team_name == "Rajasthan Royals"].player_id.dropna().astype(int))
t = pd.read_csv(W / "40666adb-teams.csv"); rcb = set(t[t.team_name.str.contains("Royal Challengers")].team_id)
TB = ["Rachin Ravindra", "Kusal Mendis", "Daryl Mitchell", "Shai Hope"]
TW = ["Matheesha Pathirana", "Gerald Coetzee", "Mitchell Starc", "Deepak Chahar", "Mujeeb Ur Rahman", "Adil Rashid", "Adam Zampa"]
rows = []
for side, targets in (("batting", TB), ("bowling", TW)):
    d = pd.read_parquet(W / f"moment_balls_{side}.parquet")
    for th, q in d.groupby("theme"):
        def f(x):
            if side == "batting": return {"balls": len(x), "stat1": 100 * x.runs.sum() / len(x), "stat2": len(x) / max(x.out.sum(), 1)}
            return {"balls": len(x), "stat1": 6 * x.brun.sum() / len(x), "stat2": len(x) / max(x.wk.sum(), 1)}
        grp = [("League", "League", q), ("Champions (RCB)", "Champions", q[q.team.isin(rcb)])]
        grp += [(x.name.iat[0], "RR now", x) for _, x in q[q.pid.isin(rr)].groupby("pid") if len(x) >= 15]
        grp += [(n, "Target", q[q.name == n]) for n in targets if (q.name == n).sum() >= 15]
        if sum(g == "Target" for _, g, _ in grp) == 0: continue
        for nm, g, x in grp:
            if len(x) == 0: continue
            r = f(x); rows.append({"area": th, "who": nm, "group": g, "balls": r["balls"], "stat1": round(r["stat1"], 1), "stat2": round(r["stat2"], 1),
                                   "stat1_label": "Strike rate" if side == "batting" else "Economy", "stat2_label": "Balls per dismissal" if side == "batting" else "Balls per wicket"})
A = pd.DataFrame(rows)
b = pd.read_parquet(W / "balls_pi.parquet", columns=["fmt", "year", "bowling_type", "legal_before", "bowling_team_id", "batting_team_id", "bowler_runs", "bowler_wkt", "legal", "is_wide", "is_nb",
                                                      "faced", "runs", "striker_out", "batting_type", "striker_name"])
ip = b[(b.fmt == "IPL") & (b.year >= 2025)].copy(); bt = ip.bowling_type.fillna("")
ip["type"] = np.where(bt.str.contains("Leg|Chinaman|off|orthodox", case=False), "Spin", "Pace")
ov = ip.legal_before // 6; ip["phase"] = np.select([ov <= 5, ov <= 14], ["Powerplay (1-6)", "Middle (7-15)"], "Death (16-20)")
L = ip[ip.legal | ip.is_wide | ip.is_nb].copy(); L["grp"] = np.where(L.bowling_team_id == 3, "RR", np.where(L.bowling_team_id.isin(rcb), "Champions (RCB)", "League"))
TP = L.groupby(["type", "phase", "grp"]).apply(lambda x: pd.Series({"overs": round(x.legal.sum() / 6), "econ": round(6 * x.bowler_runs.sum() / x.legal.sum(), 1),
                                                                   "balls_per_wkt": round(x.legal.sum() / max(x.bowler_wkt.sum(), 1), 1)})).reset_index()
fb = ip[ip.faced].copy(); fb["grp"] = np.where(fb.batting_team_id == 3, "RR", np.where(fb.batting_team_id.isin(rcb), "Champions (RCB)", "League"))
fb["hand"] = np.where(fb.batting_type == "LHB", "Left-hander", "Right-hander")
fb["btype"] = np.select([bt[fb.index].str.contains("Right-arm") & bt[fb.index].str.contains("medium|ast"), bt[fb.index].str.contains("Left-arm") & bt[fb.index].str.contains("medium|ast"),
                         bt[fb.index].str.contains("offbreak"), bt[fb.index].str.contains("orthodox"), bt[fb.index].str.contains("Leg-Break"), bt[fb.index].str.contains("Chinaman")],
                        ["Right-arm pace", "Left-arm pace", "Off-spin", "Left-arm finger spin", "Leg-spin", "Left-arm wrist spin"], "other")
BT = fb[fb.btype != "other"].groupby(["hand", "btype", "grp"]).apply(lambda x: pd.Series({"balls": len(x), "sr": round(100 * x.runs.sum() / len(x), 1),
                                                                                       "per_out": round(len(x) / max(x.striker_out.sum(), 1), 1)})).reset_index()
TOP9 = {"India", "England", "West Indies", "Australia", "Sri Lanka", "South Africa", "Afghanistan", "New Zealand", "Pakistan"}; tid = set(t[t.team_name.isin(TOP9)].team_id)
q = b[(b.year >= 2025) & b.faced & ((b.fmt == "IPL") | (b.batting_team_id.isin(tid) & b.bowling_team_id.isin(tid)))].copy(); bq = q.bowling_type.fillna("")
q["type"] = np.select([bq.str.contains("Leg-Break|Chinaman"), bq.str.contains("offbreak|orthodox"), bq.str.contains("medium|ast")], ["Wrist spin", "Finger spin", "Pace"], "other")
q = q[(q.legal_before // 6).between(6, 14) & (q.type != "other")]
ts = []
for n, g in [("League", None)] + [(n, "Target") for n in TB] + [(n, "RR now") for n in ["Riyan Parag", "Dhruv Jurel", "Yashasvi Jaiswal", "Ravindra Jadeja"]]:
    x = q if g is None else q[q.striker_name == n]
    for ty, y in x.groupby("type"):
        if len(y) >= 15: ts.append({"who": n, "group": g or "League", "type": ty, "balls": len(y), "sr": round(100 * y.runs.sum() / len(y), 1), "per_out": round(len(y) / max(y.striker_out.sum(), 1), 1)})
TS = pd.DataFrame(ts)
def dump(name, df, inputs):
    rws = json.loads(df.replace({np.nan: None}).to_json(orient="records"))
    (O / f"{name}.json").write_text(json.dumps({"rows": rws, "meta": [{"label": "s43_verify.py", "value": CODE, "type": "code", "lang": "python"}, {"label": "Input", "value": inputs}]}))
    print(name, len(rws))
dump("area_stats", A, "moment_balls_*.parquet (s38), squads2027.csv"); dump("type_phase", TP, "balls_pi.parquet, IPL 2025-26")
dump("bat_types", BT, "balls_pi.parquet, IPL 2025-26"); dump("target_spin", TS, "balls_pi.parquet, IPL + top-nine T20Is 2025-26, overs 7-15")
